newsitem.title: USA: NAPM - New York business conditions 50.9 in April.
newsitem.headline: NAPM - New York business conditions 50.9 in April.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions fell to 50.9 in April from 51.0 in March.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index also fell, to 49.4 in April from 51.6 the month before.
Manufacturing-sector conditions jumped to 64.0 from 46.0, the report said.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
"The business environment continued mixed in April but with a difference," the report said.
"In April, manufacturing activity appeared to get its 'second-wind' while the non-manufacturing sector took the earlier cue from the manufacturing sector and slipped a bit in April," it said.
Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimisim improved in April, NAPM said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 67.4 in April compared with 64.6 in March, the report said.
